ev.q: In 2012, overall, 13% of children aged <18 years had a health problem for which prescription medication had been taken regularly for ≥3 months.
Summary health statistics for U.S. children: National Health Interview Survey, 2012.
Source: Bloom B, Jones LI, Freeman G. Summary health statistics for U.S. children

methods_quotes.q: Estimates are age-adjusted using the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population and using age groups 0–4 years, 5–11 years, and 12–17 years.
Unknowns were not included in the denominators when calculating percentages.
